verdict.rationale: Snyk documents organization-level custom role templates for service accounts. The CLI Tester role grants only `snyk test` and `snyk monitor`, and the Read-Only CLI Tester role blocks `snyk monitor`. Its plans also list role-based access control. Together these give a least-privilege, non-human credential pattern an agent could use, but the evidence frames it around CI/CD pipelines, not agents, and never covers token issuance itself. Missing for 10: agent-specific credential issuance (e.g. for the MCP server/Snyk Studio), documented API token scoping, expiry and rotation controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
